summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. Adds an order detail endpoint and a POST endpoint that redeems a discount code.

findings.title: Order detail readable by any logged-in user
findings.description: order_detail looks up the order by pk only and never filters by owner. The sibling redeem view does filter by owner=request.user. Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every other user's order. They only need to enumerate integer ids. Restrict the lookup to orders that belong to request.user.

findings.fix: Restrict the lookup to orders that belong to request.user.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float raises TypeError
findings.description: self.total is a Decimal, and apply_discount multiplies it by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it multiplies a Decimal by a float. Every redeem request with the valid WELCOME10 code returns a server error. No user can apply the discount. Multiply by a Decimal and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.consequence: Every redeem request with the valid WELCOME10 code returns a server error. No user can apply the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by a Decimal and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New model field has no migration
findings.description: The change adds Order.discount_code, but orders/migrations holds only 0001_initial. No migration adds the new column. Every query on Order selects a column the database does not have. order_list, order_detail and redeem all fail with a database error. Run makemigrations and commit the migration that adds discount_code.

findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection removed from a session-authenticated POST
findings.description: redeem changes order state and authenticates through the session cookie. The decorator turns off the CSRF check that settings.py enables globally. Any third-party site can make a logged-in victim's browser change that victim's orders. No CSRF token check blocks the request. Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour has no covering test
findings.description: The repository has no tests, so nothing covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. A single test would have caught the Decimal TypeError. Regressions in discount math and order access checks reach production without anyone noticing. Add tests for apply_discount and for both new views, including access by a non-owner.
